scenes.title: A software store for Mac.
bullets: A box and a page for each
scenes.narration:
The Phin Tech Software Store puts every app in one place.
Each one gets its own box and its own page.

Scroll the shelves to see what's there.
Pick a box to read about the app.

scenes.title: Take the whole store home.
scenes.narration: Download the store, and take it all home.
